generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Tenderer must be Registered in BWSSB or registration equivalent with KPWD/CPWD etc.,and shall furnish valid registration certificate which is in currency

The Tenderer should upload the Caste Certificate in the Prescribed Format issued by GOK which is Mandatory. The Tenderer Belonging to Schedule Caste or Schedule Tribe shall be Domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years.If the Contractor is a Firm,then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to SC or ST as the case may be

Assessed available tender capacity should be (AN5-B) greater than 46.59 Lakhs, wherein A is Maximum value of Civil Engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N is Number of years B is Value of on-going works
The Form of tender as per the proforma available in KW-I should be duly filled and uploaded in the e-procurement portal as a part of tender document which is mandatory.
Amount put to tender is excluding GST. Rates quoted shall be excluding GST

The tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least ONE financial years an minimum annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.46.59 lakhs. Turnover, Profit & Loss account, Balance sheet statement certified / audited by a Chartered Accountant along with UDIN No. to be submitted.
The Tenderer should have Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor for at least any construction work to an extend of 25 % of the cost of the work with GST of Rs.11.65 lakhs
Bid capacity has to be uploaded
All the terms and conditions are as per bid document.
